content.comment_body: I'm using the Off-delay function block with a delay time of one minute. In the simulation, the delay is exactly 60 seconds, which is as expected. However, on the [product_name] hardware with [article_no], the elapsed times vary with each test. I've uploaded a brief example for reference. Does anyone have suggestions?
The way time is displayed depends on the chosen time base. I previously created an example with three different setups, each using a different time base: seconds, minutes, and hours.
Has your question been fully addressed?
